text: Hey, has anyone given the BlackRock AI/ML OA? Need some insights!

DSA Questions Asked

1. Minimize Array Sum After K Operations

The first problem involved minimizing the sum of an array after performing K operations. In each operation, any array element could be selected, replaced with ⌊x/2⌋, and inserted back into the array. Since K could be as large as 10⁶, an efficient approach was required.

The optimal solution used a max-priority queue (max-heap). At every step, the largest element was extracted, halved, and pushed back into the heap. This greedy strategy ensured that each operation produced the maximum possible reduction in the overall array sum.

Key Concepts Tested: Priority Queue, Greedy Strategy, Heap Operations, Optimization

2. Minimum Cost to Make Array Elements Distinct

The second problem involved an array and a corresponding cost array. Increasing arr[i] by 1 incurred a cost of cost[i], and the objective was to make all array elements distinct while minimizing the total cost.

Example:

Plain Text
arr = [1, 2, 3, 3, 5, 5]
cost = [2, 1, 3, 4, 5, 6]

To achieve distinct values, duplicate elements needed to be incremented strategically. The challenge was to determine which occurrences should be moved while accounting for the varying increment costs. For the example above, the minimum cost obtained was 8.

The problem primarily tested the ability to combine sorting, greedy decision-making, and cost optimization to arrive at an efficient solution.

Key Concepts Tested: Greedy Algorithms, Sorting, Optimization, Cost-Based Decision Making

Overall, both questions focused on identifying efficient greedy approaches and selecting the appropriate data structures to handle constraints effectively.----these are questions of ai ml role also there were a lot of mcqs which needed to be solved
